disclaimer: Swap suggestions are general guidance based on common physical therapy principles, not medical advice. Stop if pain increases and see a clinician.

reasons.note: Swap when no barbell or rack is available.
Swap when no bench or box is available.
Swap when no pull-up, dip or hanging bar is available.
Swap when no cable stack, machine, sled or cardio machine is available.
Limits deep or loaded knee bending and impact. Uses high-box, supported or isometric options. Stop if pain increases.
Limits deep hip flexion, wide stances and loaded hip rotation. Uses supported and pain-free-range options. Stop if pain increases.
Limits loaded spinal bending and rotation. Uses supported, seated and stability options. Stop if pain increases.
Limits overhead and deep pressing positions. Uses neutral-grip, below-shoulder-height and supported options. Stop if pain increases.
Limits weight on bent wrists and heavy straight-bar elbow loading. Uses neutral-grip, handle and cable options. Stop if pain increases.
Replaces jumping, running and landing with lower-impact options.
Gentler mobility options if a stretch or position is uncomfortable.
